name: Typst
role: Programmable typesetting and vector export CLI
notes: 2026-11-01: Typesetting to PDF, PNG and SVG for title cards, equations, tables and data-driven stills.
2026-11-01: Pass --font-path to avoid system font variation.
2026-11-24: Guide written from partial typst-title-card evidence (SVG glyphs are outlines; query deprecated for eval; PDF untested).

evidence.result: Partial: 11 of 12 predeclared checks pass. SVG viewBox 640x360pt; PNG 1280x720 RGBA 8-bit, alpha 0..255; query returned one heading; SVG and PNG reruns byte-identical; JSON variant changes SVG. SVG has no KS-7342 text (glyph outlines), so that check fails.
evidence.scope: Title card to SVG and PNG with typst 0.15.1, macOS arm64: size, alpha, query, reruns pass; SVG lacks the value as text (glyph outlines). No PDF.

summary: Open-source typesetting language and compiler for programmatic documents. The CLI compiles source into PDF, PNG or SVG and supports HTML export; it can render data-driven layouts, equations and precise text compositions. Strength: a compact, scriptable typesetting system that emits crisp vector or raster assets without a browser-based design application.
use_when: Generate typeset title cards, diagrams or data-driven stills from source files
Use over SVG hand-authoring when rich text layout, equations or reusable document templates matter
avoid_when: Use SVG directly for small hand-authored vector graphics with exact element-level control
Use Typst packages only after checking each package’s separate licence and version
license: Apache-2.0 (compiler; packages and fonts may have separate licences)

assessment.rationale: Typst 0.15.1 released 2026-07-17; official README and Cargo metadata document current CLI and Apache-2.0. It produces PDF, PNG and SVG as well as HTML, complementing rather than replacing SVG authoring for typeset graphics.
